known_tradeoffs: Revisions are exact-commit bound for CAS submission, so a descendant that jj rebased after an edit below it also gains a revision; the acceptance edit rewrites the top two changes.

Multi-member intake is resumable but not atomic: every member is admitted before the first effect, each member effect is separately journaled under a derived request id, and a retried request resumes.
jj may populate its derived index cache when loading the pinned operation; no operation, ref, bookmark or working copy is written.
Stack intake owns the dependency edges of its members and replaces manually set edges on them.

jj-dependent tests are behind the jj-fixtures feature (KILN_JJ_EXE or jj on PATH) and run in the new jj-native-fixtures flake check with pinned jj 0.43.0; the dev shell itself does not ship jj (it comes from the user PATH).
